text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.Today, we will move on to another section about writing.In this period, you will learn how to write a short message.By the end of today's lesson, you are expected to know the features of a short message by analyzing its content, language, and editing.You are also supposed to write a short message using appropriate language.Page 52 to 53 are what we need today.Got them?Good.In most cases, a short message is a kind of informal writing.You may write short messages for some simple tasks, such as to remind somebody to do something, to give thanks, to invite somebody, to make an apology, or to explain a temporary absence.Well, writing short messages is different from writing a letter or an article.We write short messages when there is a time limit.So what kind of language will you use?In most cases, you need to use incomplete and brief language.Now let's learn how to write a short message.We will analyze content, language, and editing of the three short messages on your textbook by answering the questions in exercise two on page 53.First, let's deal with the content part.Who is each short message for?Is it for a friend, a classmate, or a family member?What is the main purpose of each short message?We scan the samples quickly and fit in the content part of the table.Let's start with a short message.Who is each message for?What is the main purpose of each
